title: Fundamental Duties of Citizens
description: Learn about the constitutional duties and responsibilities of Nepali citizens that complement fundamental rights.

sections.title: Rights and Duties Balance
sections.content: Duties reinforce the reciprocal nature of constitutional democracy: exercising rights responsibly strengthens collective welfare and institutional legitimacy.

sections.title: Core Constitutional Duties
sections.content: Commonly recognized duties include upholding the Constitution, fostering harmony, protecting public property, and contributing to national service when required.

sections.title: Building Civic Culture
sections.content: Education, community participation, and volunteerism deepen civic identity and resilience against misinformation and polarization.

sections.title: Practical Application
sections.content: Daily actions—law compliance, respectful dialogue, environmental stewardship—translate abstract duties into tangible democratic contributions.

summary: Citizens uphold and protect constitutional order
